content: Mutu walunga ku mesu ma Nzambi
Mu kumanisa, baphangi bama, sangwalenu mu kukala mwena Pfumu. Bungyeku phasi mu kululandwadila mana yílusonikina kedi, mamana málusadisa mu kulutanina.
Kebenu yi bambwa
babana, kebenu yi basadi ba mbi, kebenu yi batu bana bisi lulundika mu kudikotisa mukhanda!

Mukuma betu thwenina batu babana bákota mukhanda wa mukwandi, betu babana thwisi sadila Nzambi mu nzila ya Kitembu kyandi, thwisi ditsikisila mwena Kidisitu Yesu, amana thwisiku sya kikumbwala mu mambu ma lutu.
Kinga, meni phi, yenina mawu mambu mana pfwani yisila kikumbwala muna lutu. Ho ni mutu kabanzaka ni fwani kasya kivuvu mu mambu ma lutu, meni ndungi mu kuhangabwa kuluta.

Mu kilumbu kya nana, kunima lubutuku lwama, yíkota mukhanda, yenina mukwa Kiseledi wa mukwandi, muna kanda dya Benzyame, mwisi Hebelu yenina, muna butuka dya Hebelu. Muna mana matadidi mitsiku, Mufwadisi khadikini,
muna mana matadidini zangi, yínyokuna Dibundu. Muna mana matadidini masonga mana bisi sanda batu mu nzila ya mitsiku, yíkala konda kifu.
Kaasi mambu mana mákhala hanga ndandu, mbatima mona buthwena hanga kima kya phamba kikuma kya Kidisitu.

Kaasi mbati tala mambu mana moosu hanga kima kya phamba, kikuma kya mamboti mama mahitini mu kutoka: kuzaya Kidisitu Yesu Pfumu wama, kikuma kya yandi yítambwasila mu kutotisa mambu mana moosu, amana yisi mona moosu hanga tswala, ndangu yibonga Kidisitu

amana bisa ngwana mwena yandi. Bangwanaku yi masonga ma meni-meni mana misi tuka ku mitsiku, kaasi mana misi tuka mu nzila ya lukwikilu mwena Kidisitu, masonga mamosi misi tuka kwena Nzambi amana misi yekamina mu lukwikilu.
Kima nzodini, kumuzaya Kidisitu yi ngolu za lufutumuku lwandi, kukala mu kithwadi ku phasi zandi yi kufwanana yi yandi muna lufwa lwandi,
yi kivuvu ni meni phi yifútumuka ha kati dya bafwa.
Thinu ku kinunga
Heku ni mbongima kedi mambu mana moosu, holo ni moosu mandungidi kedi; kaasi thinu mbati kwenda ndangu yibongama, kikuma Kidisitu Yesu wákhwata kedi.

Muna mambu mana mathadidini, baphangi, khwikidiku ni mbongilwa kedi lufutu meni luna; kaasi tsumbi yama yimosi: kuzimbakana mambu moosu mana menina ku manima mama amana yisya ngolu mu mambu mana menina ku thwala.
Muna bwabuna, thinu mbati kwenda yi kuna yitudila ku tsuka, ndangu yibonga lufutu luna káthedila Nzambi tuka ku zilu, mwena Kidisitu Yesu.
Disongidila, betu boosu babana twenina bakidisitu bakola, tubanzakenu bwabuna. Amana yuka ni mu dyambu dimosi bwabu, lubati banza mutindu wahika, Nzambi kalúsongilabwa wengele.
Muna moosu mamana, hana tutudi kedi buthwena, tulandenu mu kukangalaka nzila mosi.
Baphangi, landenu mbandu ya meni, amana simbululenu mboti batu babana bisi dyatila mu mutindu wa luzingu luna lwamonini kwena betu.

Mukuma, bwosu buna yisi luzimbwala kosu tangwa yi buthwena bwabu, mbati luzimbwala hika yi matsanga muna mesu, ni lawu benina babana benina bambeni ba kitakani kya Kidisitu kikuma kya ndyatidi ya bawu.
Tsuka ya bawu yenina kuzangana, nzambi wa bawu kenina kundu dya bawu; amana khembu ya bawu yenina muna mambu mana misi bakwatisa tsoni amana bisi sya mabanza ma bawu muna bima bya tsi.
Kaasi kwena betu, thwenina bisi mbanza ya mazilu. Amana tukidila kwakuna, tubati hingila hanga muhuludi, Pfumu Yesu Kidisitu.
Yandi wuna wakwisa balumuna lutu lwetu luna lwisi fwa ndangu lwakituka hanga lutu lwandi lwa khembu, muna nzila ya ngolu zina zisi muheka hamu dya kusya bima byosu muna sina dya luyalu lwandi.

footnotes.text: Muna tangwa dina, mbwa bakala mumona hanga mbisi mosi walewuka. Muhowu wawu wubati zonzila batu bana bakala tsikisa mukhanda. Tala hika muna Mth 7:6.
